name: SCCM: Tier Zero Computer Representations
description: Keep the SCCM client and mapped AD computer in Tier Zero when either representation already has Tag_Tier_Zero. Requires SCCM_SameHostAs; it does not mark every client in a Tier Zero hierarchy.
cypher:
// Keep the SCCM client and AD computer in T0 when either is already T0.
MATCH (device:SCCM_ClientDevice)-[:SCCM_SameHostAs]->(computer:Computer)
WHERE computer:Tag_Tier_Zero OR device:Tag_Tier_Zero
// Return only the two matching representations.
MATCH (n)-[:SCCM_SameHostAs*0..1]->(computer)
WHERE n = computer OR n = device
RETURN DISTINCT n
